insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for unfulfilled orders. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update is effective as of September 9, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their order update logic to ensure it accounts for the recalculated taxes. This change may affect how orders are processed and fulfilled, particularly for orders with shipping address changes. The orderUpdate mutation in the GraphQL Admin API is impacted, so developers should test their implementations to ensure compatibility. Additionally, developers should be aware that this change may introduce additional complexity when handling order updates, especially if their apps rely on specific tax calculation logic.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses, which can help reduce errors and improve the overall customer experience.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures compliance with tax regulations, which is crucial for merchants and developers alike. It also reflects Shopify's ongoing efforts to enhance the platform's functionality and reliability.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront functionality, improve development experience

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support is available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores. This update also includes the ability to update cart attributes and fire events when attributes are updated.

themes.title: Development and Deployment
themes.detail: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores. Additionally, the Shopify CLI has been updated to serve UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enabling developers to attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders using the GraphQL Admin API.
